hebrewText: חֶ֥סֶד וֶ/אֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥/ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥/ם עַל גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑י/ךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗/ם עַל ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽ/ךָ

tokens.bdb: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
tokens.kjv: favour, good deed(-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: kindness; by implication  piety; rarely  reproof
tokens.enLiteralWord: kindness; by implication  piety; rarely  reproof
tokens.explanation: kindness; by implication  piety; rarely  reproof
tokens.explanationEn: kindness; by implication  piety; rarely  reproof

tokens.kjv: assured(-ly), establishment, faithful, right, sure, true (-ly, -th), verity.

tokens.bdb: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
tokens.kjv: nay, neither, [phrase] never, no, nor, not, nothing (worth), rather than.

tokens.bdb: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
tokens.kjv: commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: to tie, physically (gird, confine, compact) or mentally (in love, league)
tokens.kjv: bind (up), (make a) conspire(-acy, -ator), join together, knit, stronger, work (treason).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
